source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Asosiy mexanizm: FOB atsetilxolinesteraza (AChE) fermentiga bog‘lanib, uni ingibirlaydi va xolinergik inqirozni keltirib chiqaradi.

bullets.text: Kasalxonada o‘limning keng tarqalgan sababi nafas yetishmovchiligi, so‘ng yurak to‘xtashi.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun FOB zaharlanishi ham pestitsid, ham jangovar agent muammosi sifatida o‘rganiladi? 2) Qaysi ikki asosiy o‘lim sababini eslaysiz? Doskaga chizish: FOB → AChE ingibitsiyasi → atsetilxolin to‘planishi → xolinergik inqiroz zanjiri. Tipik xato: FOB va karbamatlarni bir xil mexanizm deb aralashtirish; talabalar bu slaydda faqat FOB haqida gapirilishini unutmasin.

slides.title: Epidemiologiya: jahon ko‘rsatkichlari

bullets.text: Yiliga 3 milliondan ortiq og‘ir o‘tkir zaharlanish bo‘lishi taxmin qilinadi; ro‘yxatga olinmagan holatlar undan ham ko‘p.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: 300 000 — barcha pestitsidlar, 110 000 — faqat FOB; bu raqamlarni aralashtirmang.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: I sinf pestitsidlar (paration, mevinfos) taqiqlangach, FOB bilan o‘z-o‘ziga zaharlanishdan o‘lim kamaygan.

source.author: Worek et al.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun manbalar turlicha raqam beradi? 2) Taqiqlash chora sifatida qanday samara berdi? Doskaga chizish: 2007 va 2017 yillar uchun o‘lim kamayishini ko‘rsatuvchi oddiy vaqt chizig‘i. Tipik xato: bitta raqamni jahon uchun yagona haqiqat deb yozib olish; har bir raqam qamrovi (barcha pestitsid yoki faqat FOB) va yiliga bog‘liq.

slides.title: Letallik: rivojlanayotgan va G‘arb mamlakatlari

bullets.text: Letallik yuqori bo‘lishining sabablari: zaharli moddalar, uzoq transport, shifokor va antidotlar yetishmasligi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Sun’iy ventilyatsiyadagi bemorlarda o‘lim 50% dan oshishi mumkin.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: letallik (o‘lganlar ulushi) ≠ o‘limlar soni; bular turli ko‘rsatkichlar.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun G‘arbda letallik bunchalik past? 2) Ventilyatsiyadagi bemorlarda yuqori o‘lim nimani anglatadi: usul sababmi yoki og‘irlik belgisimi? Doskaga chizish: uch ustunli oddiy taqqoslash chizig‘i (rivojlanayotgan / ayrim pestitsid / G‘arb). Tipik xato: 10–20% va 50–70% ni bitta ko‘rsatkich deb olish; ikkinchisi faqat ayrim pestitsidlarga tegishli.

slides.title: Yuqori letallik sabablari

bullets.text: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda o‘z-o‘zini zaharlashda letallik odatda 10–20%, ayrim pestitsidlarda esa 50–70% gacha yetadi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: G‘arb mamlakatlarida barcha sabablar bo‘yicha o‘z-o‘zini zaharlashdagi letallik 0,3% dan kam. Farq juda katta.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Sabablar ko‘p omilli: mahalliy zaharlarning yuqori toksikligi, bemorni kasalxonaga olib borishdagi uzoq masofa va tibbiyot xodimlarining kamligi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Jihozlar, antidotlar va xodimlarni o‘qitish yetishmaydi. Davolash protokollarini tuzish uchun isbotlangan usullar ham kam.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama savoli: nima uchun bir xil zaharlanishda letallik G‘arbda 0,3% dan kam, rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda esa 10–20%? Doskada chizish: ‘letallik sabablari’ ro‘yxatini 4 ustunli ro‘yxat ko‘rinishida yozdiring (zahar, masofa, xodim, antidot). Tipik xato: letallikni faqat zaharning toksikligi bilan izohlash; manbada sabablar ko‘p omilli deyilgan.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: olis qishloqdagi zaharlanish

bullets.text: Vaziyat: qishloqda FOB (fosfororganik birikmalar) ichgan bemor kasalxonaga uzoq yo‘l bilan keltirildi. U terga botgan, qorachiqlari nuqtadek, nafasi og‘ir.

source.page: PMID 37047631; DOI 10.3390/ijms24076658 (2. Organophosphorus Compounds as Insecticides and as Nerve Agents)

bullets.text: Ayrim ma‘lumotlarga ko‘ra, rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda bemorlar qabuldan keyin tez orada o‘ladi. Shuning uchun dastlabki barqarorlashtirish muhim.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Savol: o‘lim xavfini oshirgan omillarni sanang. Qabul bo‘limida birinchi navbatda nimani tekshirasiz (nafas yo‘li, nafas, qon aylanishi)?

source.author: Eddleston et al.

(2) qabulda birinchi qadam nima (ABC: nafas yo‘li, nafas, qon aylanishi)? Doskada chizish: bemorning yo‘li – zahar ichishdan qabul bo‘limigacha – vaqt chizig‘i. Tipik xato: oshqozonni yuvishdan boshlash; avval bemorni barqarorlashtirish kerak.

slides.title: FOB guruhlari va qo‘llanilishi

bullets.text: FOB (fosfororganik birikmalar) guruhlari: fosfatlar, fosfonatlar, fosfinatlar va fosforotioatlar. Ular tuzilishi va toksikligi bo‘yicha juda xilma-xil.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Qishloq xo‘jaligida pestitsidlar hosilni hasharot, kana, nematoda, zamburug‘, kemiruvchi, qush va begona o‘tlardan himoya qiladi.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Pestitsidlar turmush va dam olish sharoitlarida ham ishlatiladi. Qo‘llanish faqat rivojlanayotgan emas, rivojlangan mamlakatlarga ham yoyilgan.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: FOB bilan zaharlanish ular joriy etilgan 1950-yillar boshidan qayd etilgan. Holatlar tez-tez uchrab, ijtimoiy ofat darajasiga yetgan.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama savollari: FOB guruhlarini sanab bering; nima uchun FOB hayotimizda keng uchraydi? Doskada chizish: FOB uchun umumiy ‘guruhlar’ daraxti (4 shox) va uning yonida qo‘llanish joylari (dala, uy, dam olish). Tipik xato: FOB faqat qishloq xo‘jaligi zahari deb o‘ylash; manbada turmush va dam olish sharoitlari ham keltirilgan.

slides.title: Pestitsidlar va asab agentlari: umumiy mexanizm

bullets.text: Fosfororganik birikmalar (FOB) samarali insektitsidlar tarkibiga kiradi, ayrimlari esa harbiy asab agentidir.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Sarin, VX kabi asab agentlari ham, pestitsidlar ham atsetilxolinesterazani (AChE) ingibitsiyalaydi. Zaharlilik darajasi birikma tuzilishiga bog‘liq.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: FOB Matsumoto (1994) va Tokio (1995) teraktlarida, Iroq va Suriyada qurol sifatida, Kuala-Lumpur va Salisberidagi suiqasdlarda ishlatilgan.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Sarin shilliq qavat orqali tez ta’sir qiladi, VX teri orqali kechikib. O‘z joniga qasd qilishda pestitsid asosan og‘iz orqali kiradi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun pestitsid va asab agenti belgilari o‘xshash? 2) Kirish yo‘li zaharlanish tezligiga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada: ikki ustunli ro‘yxat chizing (pestitsidlar | asab agentlari) va ularga umumiy mexanizmni yozing. Tipik xato: asab agentlari va pestitsidlarning mexanizmi har xil deb o‘ylash. Aslida mexanizm umumiy, zaharlilik darajasi va kirish yo‘li farq qiladi.

slides.title: Ta’sir mexanizmi: AChE ingibitsiyasi

bullets.text: FOB atsetilxolinesteraza (AChE) faol markazidagi seringa kovalent bog‘lanadi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Atsetilxolin (ACh) parchalanmasa, signal uzatilishi davom etadi va asab funksiyasi ortiqcha faollashadi.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Belgilar: miozis, so‘lak va ter ajralishi, bradikardiya, fassikulyatsiya, hushni yo‘qotish.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun ACh yig‘ilishi miozis va bradikardiyaga olib keladi? 2) Qaysi belgilar muskarin, qaysilari nikotin ta’siriga mansub? Doskada: zanjir sxemasini tugunma-tugun chizing va har tugunga bitta belgi yozing. Tipik xato: ingibitsiyalanadigan narsa ACh deb o‘ylash. Aslida ingibitsiyalanadigan narsa fermentning o‘zi (AChE).

slides.title: Ingibitsiya qaytmasligi va ferment tiklanishi

bullets.text: Ramadori fikricha, ingibitsiya amalda qaytmas. U zaharni fermentdan ajratadigan dori yo‘q deb hisoblaydi.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Normal holat jigarda, suyak iligida va ayniqsa sinapslarda yangi ferment sintezlanishi bilan tiklanadi. ACh ortiqchaligi haftalar davom etishi mumkin.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: atropin reaktivator emas. U fermentni tiklamaydi, faqat muskarin belgilarini bosadi va nikotin ta’sirini to‘smaydi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Oksimlar fosfil qoldig‘ini fermentdan olib tashlashi kerak. Qarigan AChE ni tiklay olmaydi, odamdagi pestitsid zaharlanishida foydasi munozarali.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun atropin faqat simptomatik davo hisoblanadi? 2) Qarish (aging) oksim samarasini qanday cheklaydi? Doskada: AChE holatlari sxemasini chizing (ingibitsiyalangan → tiklangan yoki qarigan). Tipik xato: atropin fermentni tiklaydi deb o‘ylash. Eslatma: manbalar oksimlar bo‘yicha bir fikrda emas, shuni talabalarga ochiq ayting.

slides.title: “Qarish” (aging) va spontan reaktivatsiya

bullets.text: FOB (fosfororganik birikma) bilan bloklangan atsetilxolinesteraza (AChE) tiklanishi yoki qarishi mumkin.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Pralidoksim (2-PAM) va obidoksim qarigan AChE ni tiklay olmaydi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Somanda oksim samarasiz; dimetil-FOB (malation, dimetoat)da spontan reaktivatsiya oksimga yordam beradi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun oksim somanda deyarli foydasiz? 2) Qarishgacha o‘tgan vaqt davolash taktikasiga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada chizish: AChE → ingibitorlangan (EP) → ikki yo‘l: spontan reaktivatsiya (E) yoki qarish (EA). Tipik xato: qarish va spontan reaktivatsiyani bir narsa deb o‘ylash; ular qarama-qarshi jarayonlar.

slides.title: Tezkor savol 1: mexanizm va epidemiologiya

bullets.text: Savol: FOB AChE ni qanday bloklaydi va nega somanda “qarish” oksim ta’sirini yo‘qqa chiqaradi?

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Talaba javobi: FOB AChE faol markaziga kovalent bog‘lanadi. Soman bloklagan ferment ~2 daqiqada qariydi, oksim uni tiklay olmaydi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda o‘z-o‘zini pestitsid bilan zaharlashda letallik odatda 10–20%, ayrim pestitsidlarda 50–70% gacha.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Diqqat: qarish (aging) ≠ spontan reaktivatsiya. Birida ferment oksimga bo‘ysunmaydi, ikkinchisida o‘zi tiklanadi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daq. Bitta talabani chaqirib javob so‘rang, keyin guruh to‘ldirsin. Muhokama: letallik ko‘rsatkichi nima uchun mamlakatlar o‘rtasida farq qiladi? Doskada chizish: mexanizm zanjiri FOB → AChE bloklanishi → atsetilxolin to‘planishi → xolinergik krizis. Tipik xato: letallikni faqat zahar toksikligiga bog‘lash; transport, kadr va antidot yetishmasligi ham ahamiyatli.

slides.title: Toksikokinetika: kirish yo‘llari

bullets.text: Bug‘ bosimi (25 °C): sarin 2,9 mmHg, VX 0,0007 mmHg. VX lipofil va teri orqali xavfli.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Og‘iz orqali: P450 oksonga aylantiradi, paraoksonaza (PON1) zararsizlaydi, lipofillik yog‘da ushlaydi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: VX teri orqali: qondagi maksimum 2–4 soatda (hayvonlarda); sarinning yarim chiqarilishi <60 daqiqa.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun VX belgilari kechikib boshlanadi? 2) Lipofil FOB (masalan, fention) bemorni kuzatishga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada chizish: kirish yo‘li → qonga o‘tish → AChE ingibitsiyasi → belgilar boshlanishi. Tipik xato: barcha FOB bir xil tezlikda va bir xil yo‘l bilan ta’sir qiladi deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Tionlar: oksonga aylanish va yog‘da to‘planish

bullets.text: Tion (pro-zahar) turidagi fosfororganik birikma (FOB) o‘zi faol emas; faol oksonga aylanib toksik bo‘ladi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Tionning oksonga aylanishi sitoxrom P450 fermenti orqali ketadi va zahar ta’sirining tezligiga ta’sir qiladi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

bullets.text: Fention kabi yog‘da eruvchi FOB yog‘ depolaridan kunlar, hatto haftalar davomida qonga sekin chiqadi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega tion ichilgan zahot belgilar bo‘lmasligi mumkin? 2) Yog‘da eruvchanlik davolash muddatiga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada: 5 bosqichli zanjirni chizdiring va har bosqichga bitta xavfni yozdiring. Tipik xato: tion bilan okson bir xil faol modda deb o‘ylash; ular farqli: tion – pro-zahar, okson – faol shakl.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: fention ichgan bemor

bullets.text: Vaziyat: bemor fention ichgach ko‘p o‘tmay keldi; miyoz va terlash yo‘q, o‘pka tiniq, xolinergik belgilar hali ko‘rinmaydi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Diqqat: belgisizlik ≠ xavfsizlik. Tion faollashishi va fention yog‘dan chiqishi bilan belgilar keyin paydo bo‘lishi mumkin.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Belgilar bo‘lmasa atropin hozir kerak emas, ammo puxta kuzatuv shart; barqarorlashgach dastlabki 6 soat kamida soatiga bir marta ko‘rik.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

bullets.text: Savol: nega dastlabki “yengil” ko‘rinish aldamchi bo‘lishi mumkin va fention bilan qaytalanish xavfi nima uchun yuqori?

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Bemorni kuzatuvsiz uyga jo‘natish qanday oqibat beradi? 2) Qaytalanishda qaysi belgilarga e’tibor beriladi (bo‘yin fleksiyasi zaifligi, nafas)? Doskada: soatlar bo‘yicha kuzatuv jadvalini (0–6 soat, keyin 2–3 soatda) chizdiring. Tipik xato: belgilar yo‘qligidan zaharlanish yo‘q degan xulosa chiqarish.

slides.title: Xolinergik sindrom: muskarin va nikotin belgilari

bullets.text: Atsetilxolin parchalanmay qoladi; muskarin va nikotin retseptorlari haddan tashqari qo‘zg‘aladi.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Nikotin retseptorlari orqali xavfli periferik nafas bloki rivojlanishi mumkin; atropin buni bartaraf eta olmaydi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

Doskada chizish: 5 ta asosiy xulosa va o‘lim sabablari ro‘yxati. Tipik xato: oksim yoki laboratoriya (xolinesteraza) natijasini kutib, favqulodda davoni kechiktirish. Davo klinik belgilarga qarab boshlanadi. Sabablari: nafas yetishmovchiligi, so‘ng yurak to‘xtashi, sepsis, gipovolemik shok.

mcq.question: Bemorning ko‘z qorachig‘i nuqtadek toraygan, badani ter bilan qoplangan, bronxoreya bor. Bu manzaraning asosiy sababi qaysi?
mcq.explanation: Fosfororganik birikmalar (FOB) atsetilxolinesterazaning serin qoldig‘iga kovalent bog‘lanib, uni ingibitsiya qiladi. Atsetilxolin parchalanmaydi va signal uzatilishi davom etadi. Shundan xolinergik krizis kelib chiqadi: miyoz, ko‘p terlash, bronxoreya va bronxospazm. Atsetilxolinning kam ajralishi yoki esterazaning faollashuvi mexanizmga teskari; retseptorlar bloklanishi esa atropin ta’siriga xos.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Shifokor rivojlanayotgan mamlakatda pestitsid bilan o‘z-o‘zini zaharlash holatlarida o‘rtacha letallikni baholamoqda. Manbaga ko‘ra, odatiy ko‘rsatkich qaysi?
mcq.explanation: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda o‘z-o‘zini zaharlashdagi letallik odatda 10–20 foiz. Ayrim pestitsidlarda u 50–70 foizgacha yetadi, lekin bu odatiy emas. G‘arb mamlakatlarida barcha sabablar bo‘yicha letallik 0,3 foizdan kam.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: 2007 yildan 2017 yilgacha FOB bilan o‘z-o‘zini zaharlashdan jahon bo‘yicha o‘lim kamayishiga qaysi chora hissa qo‘shgan?
options: Paration kabi yuqori toksik I sinf pestitsidlarni taqiqlash
mcq.explanation: Parathion va mevinphos kabi yuqori toksik I sinf pestitsidlarning taqiqlanishi yillik o‘limni 2007 yildagi taxminan 258 000 dan ortiq holatdan 2017 yilda taxminan 110 000 ga tushirishga hissa qo‘shgan. Bu raqam hanuzgacha juda yuqori. Boshqa variantlar manbada ko‘rsatilmagan.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

mcq.question: Fosfororganik birikmalar (FOB) kimyoviy guruhlarini qaysi qator to‘g‘ri sanaydi?
mcq.explanation: Fosforning organik kimyosi bo‘yicha uzoq yillik tadqiqotlar fosfatlar, fosfonatlar, fosfinatlar va fosforotioatlar guruhlarining paydo bo‘lishiga olib kelgan. Ularning ayrimlari pestitsid, ayrimlari jangovar asab agenti sifatida ishlatilgan. Boshqa qatorlardagi birikmalar FOB guruhiga kirmaydi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

mcq.question: Bemor soman bilan zaharlangan, oksim bilan davo kech boshlandi. Oksim nega samarasiz bo‘lishi mumkin?
options: Oksim atropinning muskarin retseptoriga ta’sirini bloklaydi
Soman AChE bilan qaytar va zaif bog‘lanish hosil qiladi
Soman faqat BChE ni ingibitsiyalaydi, AChE ga ta’sir qilmaydi
Ingibitsiyalangan AChE tez “qarib”, oksim tiklay olmaydi
mcq.explanation: Soman bilan ingibitsiyalangan AChE da “qarish” (dealkillanish) juda tez kechadi, yarim davri taxminan 2 daqiqa. Qarigan ferment oksim bilan reaktivatsiya bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun oksim davosi samarasiz bo‘ladi. Dimetil-FOB da esa spontan reaktivatsiya mumkin.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

mcq.question: Terisiga tushgan, o‘ta kam uchuvchan va lipofil VX bilan zaharlanishda toksik belgilar qachon boshlanadi?
options: Kechikib, bir necha soatdan keyin boshlanadi
Bir necha daqiqada, shilliq pardalar orqali boshlanadi
Hech qanday o‘tkir belgi bo‘lmaydi, faqat surunkali ta’sir bo‘ladi
Faqat og‘iz orqali kirganda boshlanadi, teri orqali kirmaydi
mcq.explanation: VX ning bug‘ bosimi juda past, u lipofil va asosan teri orqali kiradi, belgilari kechikib (soatlarda) paydo bo‘ladi. Sarin esa uchuvchan bo‘lib, shilliq pardalar orqali kiradi va belgilar daqiqalarda boshlanadi.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

mcq.question: Tion guruhidagi FOB ichgan bemorda dastlab xolinergik belgilar yo‘q edi, keyin paydo bo‘ldi. Buning sababi nima?
options: Tion qonda atropin bilan birikib, faolsizlanadi
Oksim ta’sirida AChE yangidan sintezlanib ketadi
Tion sitoxrom P450 orqali faol oksonga aylanadi
mcq.explanation: Tionlar (organofosforotioatlar) o‘zi kuchsiz ingibitor bo‘lib, sitoxrom P450 ta’sirida faol oksonga aylanadi. Shuning uchun belgilar kechikib chiqishi mumkin va bemorni diqqat bilan kuzatish kerak. Fention kabi yog‘da eruvchi FOB yog‘dan sekin chiqib, belgilarni qaytarishi ham mumkin.

source.author: Worek et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus compounds and oximes: a critical review, Archives of Toxicology

mcq.question: FOB atsetilxolinesterazani ingibitsiyalagandan keyin, sinapslarda xolinergik belgilar haftalab saqlanishi asosan nimaga bog‘liq?
options: Yangi AChE yetarlicha sintezlanguncha ACh ortiqcha qolishiga
Qon zardobida albumin miqdori oshib ketishiga
mcq.explanation: Ingibitsiya amalda qaytmas, fermentni zahardan ajratadigan dori yo‘q. Atsetilxolin ortiqcha holda sinapslarda yangi, mahalliy sintezlangan AChE yetarli bo‘lguncha haftalab saqlanishi mumkin. Oksimlarning bu muddatni qisqartirishi hali munozarali.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Bemor ter bilan qoplangan, qorachiqlari nuqtadek, nafasi og‘ir; pestitsid keng tarqalgan hududda. Qanday qaror to‘g‘ri?
options: Avval xolinesteraza faolligi tahlili natijasini kutish kerak
Avval oshqozonni yuvib, so‘ng davoni tanlashga o‘tish kerak
Darhol atropin berish kerak, bu belgilar yetarli asos bo‘ladi
Atropin bermasdan, faqat qisqa muddat kuzatuvda qoldirish kerak
mcq.explanation: Nuqtadek qorachiq va ko‘p terlash FOB/karbamatdan zaharlanishni ko‘rsatadi va atropin berishga asos bo‘ladi. Besh asosiy belgi: miozis, ko‘p terlash, bronxoreya/bronxospazm tufayli havo kirishining yomonlashuvi, bradikardiya, gipotenziya. Laboratoriya tahlilini kutib bo‘lmaydi, dekontaminatsiya esa bemor stabillashgandan keyin qilinadi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: FOB bilan zaharlangan bemor boshini yostiqdan ko‘tarishga qiynalmoqda. Bu holat birinchi navbatda nimani ko‘rsatishi mumkin?
mcq.explanation: Bo‘yin bukuvchi mushaklarining zaifligi oraliq sindromning erta belgisi. Keyin yordamchi nafas mushaklari ishlashi, burun qanotlari kengayishi, tezlashgan nafas, kranial nervlar falaji va proksimal mushaklar zaifligi qo‘shiladi. Bo‘yni zaif bemorlarning hammasida to‘liq sindrom rivojlanmaydi, lekin ular xavf ostida va muntazam kuzatilishi kerak.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: Hushsiz FOB bemori kelganda ABC tekshirilib, kislorod berildi. Aspiratsiya xavfini kamaytirish uchun bemorni qaysi holatga yotqizish kerak?
options: Chap yon bilan, ideal holda boshi pastga
mcq.explanation: Protokolga ko‘ra bemor chap yon holatiga, ideal holda boshi pastga qaratib yotqiziladi. Bu aspiratsiya xavfini kamaytiradi. Bo‘yinni yozish nafas yo‘lini ochiq tutishga yordam beradi. Tutqanoq bo‘lsa, darhol vena ichiga diazepam beriladi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: Atropin yuklangandan 3–5 daqiqa o‘tdi, lekin besh ko‘rsatkich bo‘yicha izchil yaxshilanish yo‘q. Keyingi to‘g‘ri qadam qaysi?
options: Boshlang‘ich dozani aynan o‘sha miqdorda takrorlash
mcq.explanation: Javob bo‘lmasa, doza ikki barobar oshiriladi va har safar javob bo‘lmaganda yana ikki barobar qilinadi. Boshlang‘ich dozani oddiy takrorlash noto‘g‘ri: ba’zi bemorlarga o‘nlab yoki yuzlab mg kerak bo‘ladi, 3 mg dan takrorlash soatlab vaqt oladi. Og‘ir bemor shu vaqtgacha o‘lib qolishi mumkin.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: Atropin infuziyasi olayotgan bemorda chalkashlik, isitma va ichak shovqinlarining yo‘qligi aniqlandi. Birinchi navbatda nima qilinadi?
options: Infuziyani to‘xtatib, 30 daqiqadan keyin qayta baholash
Faqat yurak urishiga qarab dozani oshirish
mcq.explanation: Uchala belgi bo‘lsa, atropin ortiqcha berilmoqda. Infuziya to‘xtatiladi va 30 daqiqadan keyin belgilar pasayganini tekshiriladi. Pasaysa, avvalgi tezlikning 70–80 foizidan qayta boshlanadi. Yurak urishi va qorachiq o‘lchamiga tayanib bo‘lmaydi, chunki ular nikotin va muskarin ta’siri balansiga bog‘liq.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: FOB bilan zaharlangan hushsiz bemorda tutqanoq boshlandi. Dastlabki yordam protokoliga ko‘ra qaysi harakat darhol qilinadi?
mcq.explanation: Dastlabki baholashda tutqanoqqa e’tibor beriladi va u bo‘lsa, darhol vena ichiga diazepam beriladi. Oshqozonni tozalash bemor barqarorlashgandan keyin, kerak bo‘lsa intubatsiyadan so‘ng ko‘rib chiqiladi. Ipekakuana FOB bilan zaharlanganda qo‘llanmaydi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: Hushsiz, intubatsiya qilinmagan bemor FOB bilan zaharlangan. Dekontaminatsiya haqida qaysi qaror to‘g‘ri?
options: Darhol oshqozonni yuvib, keyin bemorni barqarorlashtirish
Avval bemorni barqarorlashtirib, zarur bo‘lsa intubatsiya qilish
Ipekak berib, qusishni chaqirib oshqozonni bo‘shatish
Faqat faollangan ko‘mir berib, boshqa chora ko‘rmaslik
mcq.explanation: Dekontaminatsiya bemor barqarorlashgandan va kerak bo‘lsa intubatsiya qilingandan keyin o‘ylanadi. Ipekak zaharlanganlarda qarshi ko‘rsatma. Hushsiz, intubatsiyasiz bemorda oshqozon yuvish o‘limgacha asoratlar xavfini tug‘diradi.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: FOB bilan zaharlangan bemor qattiq qo‘zg‘algan va tana harorati baland. Qaysi usul to‘g‘ri tanlov?
options: Galoperidolni yuqori dozada vena ichiga berish
Diazepamni sekin vena ichiga berib, bemorni sovitish
mcq.explanation: Qo‘zg‘alishda diazepam sekin tomir ichiga beriladi, bemor nam sochiq va ventilyator bilan sovitiladi. Bog‘lab qo‘yilgan bemor kurashib, ortiqcha issiqlik hosil qiladi va gipertermik yurak to‘xtashi xavfi ortadi. Galoperidol ham afzal emas.

source.author: Eddleston et al.
source.title: Early management after self-poisoning with an organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide – a treatment protocol for junior doctors, Critical Care

mcq.question: Kasalxonaga yotqizilgan FOB bilan zaharlangan bemorlarda eng ko‘p uchraydigan o‘lim sababi qaysi?
options: Miokard infarkti va bosh miya shishi
mcq.explanation: Manbalarda eng ko‘p o‘lim sababi nafas yetishmovchiligi, undan keyin yurak to‘xtashi, sepsis va gipovolemik shok sanaladi. Ikkinchi manba ham o‘limlarning ko‘pi nafas yetishmovchiligidan ekanini qayd etadi.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Bemorda qayt qilish, ich ketishi, ter va bronx sekretsiyasi ko‘p, siydik kam, bosim past, yurak sekin urmoqda. Atropindan keyingi birinchi davo yo‘nalishi qaysi?
options: Faqat oksimlar dozasini oshirib, AChE ni tiklash
Albumin va suyuqlik infuzi bilan hajmni tiklash
mcq.explanation: Suyuqlik yo‘qotilishi gipovolemiya va to‘qima gipoksiyasiga olib keladi. Atropindan keyin birinchi chora sifatida vena ichiga albumin va suyuqlik berib, qon hajmi va to‘qima kislorodlanishi tiklanadi. Bu holat sepsisga o‘xshab ketishi mumkin.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Bemor 200 ml diklorvos ichgan, og‘ir atsidoz bor, qon albumini 1 g/dL gacha tushgan. Qaysi muolaja muvaffaqiyatli qo‘llangan?
options: Faqat yangi muzlatilgan plazma va oksimlar berish
Faqat gemodializ va yuqori dozali antibiotik berish
Albumin, suyuqlik va natriy bikarbonat infuzi qilish
Faqat mexanik ventilyatsiya va diuretik qo‘llash
mcq.explanation: Muvaffaqiyatli holatda 125 g albumin, 6,5 litr suyuqlik va natriy bikarbonat infuz qilingan. Gipoalbuminemiya uzoq davom etgan gipovolemiya bilan bog‘langan. Oksimlar AChE ingibitsiyasini kamaytirishda foydali ko‘rinmaydi.

source.author: Ramadori et al.
source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Kasalxonaga tushgan FOB bilan zaharlangan bemorda yuqori CRP va past albumin aniqlandi. Bu natijalarni qanday sharhlash to‘g‘ri?
options: Faqat sepsis belgisi, shuning uchun antibiotik shart
To‘qima ishemiyasi va gipovolemiya belgisi sifatida
mcq.explanation: Muallif yallig‘lanish markerlari va gipoalbuminemiyani asosan gipovolemiyadan kelib chiqqan to‘qima ishemiyasi belgisi deb baholaydi, atsetilxolin parchalanishining kamayishi bevosita sababi deb emas. Shu sababli ular salbiy prognostik markerlardir.

source.title: Organophosphorus Poisoning: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and Cardiac Failure as Cause of Death in Hospitalized Patients, International Journal of Molecular Sciences
